test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical! order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:

Option 3) BVP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76d4c42e8a32b63c85c1a0a2bf4db217d12cbc8772459bfa5512b7017e65fdea.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d591da5ed1a60008d5208665e29f29152cb400e5ee8fdd6d8ecfecaa6de8aab7.png] 

Option 4) KEY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91987b9f60def458f7ad71ccf7701b6e3517bd735ddd7e71d3f9294263f7eab5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da1400eb9fe5ab90ab705f9dfd6b69768d4c4369c3ddf5ce6fd7b993b7c984d6.png]

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
